status: Nominal research assumptions, not calibrated hardware parameters
support_note: Ideal passive support approximation near original rear ground-contact coordinates. Normal contact only at zero friction; no caster swivel/rolling inertia. Straight motion on flat ground only.

actuator_note: Added inertia, damping, wheel/head/finger caps are explicit hypotheses; free base gets zero artificial armature/damping.
